components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Routine high-priority product action with near-black fill.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Create widget <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m13 6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 12px 17px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-ink, #111111); color: #fff; font: 500 12px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 3px 7px #1111110c; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2a2a2a; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px #11111122; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Singular persuasive or activation action using Widget Blue.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-accent">Create my own widget <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m13 6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { min-height: 50px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-accent, #2563eb); color: #fff; font: 650 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px #2563eb24; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: var(--color-accent-strong, #1d4ed8); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px #2563eb35; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Reversible or lower-priority action on a soft neutral surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 12px 17px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e5e5); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-secondary, #f3f3f3); color: var(--color-ink, #111111); font: 500 12px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e9e9e9; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact white field with a crisp border and blue focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 9px; color: var(--color-ink, #111111); font: 500 12px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field { width: 100%; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e5e5); border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; color: var(--color-ink, #111111); font: 400 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted, #666666); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #d4d4d4; } .ds-field:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: White, bottom-bordered product header with a blue active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { height: 62px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e5e5); background: #fff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-brand { margin-right: 8px; color: var(--color-ink, #111111); font-size: 23px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -1px; } .ds-brand span { color: var(--color-accent, #2563eb); } .ds-nav-item { align-self: stretch; padding: 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: none; color: var(--color-muted, #666666); font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #111111); } .ds-nav-active { border-color: var(--color-accent, #2563eb); color: var(--color-accent-strong, #1d4ed8); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact connected-state label with a pale blue surface.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-accent-soft, #eff6ff); color: var(--color-accent-strong, #1d4ed8); font: 600 9px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-accent, #2563eb); }

components.css: .ds-card { width: min(360px, 100%); padding: 26px; border: 1px solid #f0f0f0; border-radius: 17px; background: #fff; color: var(--color-ink, #111111); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px #11111104; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-card-icon { width: 45px; height: 45px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 25px; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--color-accent-soft, #eff6ff); color: var(--color-accent-strong, #1d4ed8); font-weight: 700; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-card p { margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--color-subdued, #737373); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.9; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-border, #e5e5e5); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Quiet square control for close, delete, and utility actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" aria-label="Close"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted, #666666); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: var(--color-surface, #f3f3f3); color: var(--color-ink, #111111); } .ds-icon-button:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Widget Now feels like a precise personal utility: quiet enough to keep data in charge, but confident enough to make each next action obvious. Pure white space, near-black type, light-grey surfaces, and a single clear blue accent create a crisp working canvas for content gathered from the web.

The system is compact rather than cramped. Small labels, economical controls, and firm alignment support quick scanning, while rounded widget silhouettes and restrained depth keep the product approachable. Individual widgets may carry their own theme colors; those colors belong to the content preview and do not redefine the application identity.
keyCharacteristics: Pure-white working canvas with near-black interface ink.
Blue reserved for active, linked, focused, and high-intent moments.
Compact controls, crisp borders, and restrained ambient shadows.
Rounded widgets are expressive; surrounding product chrome stays quieter.
Responsive layouts simplify and stack without changing the visual voice.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Application chrome uses Widget Blue as its only saturated brand accent; theme colors inside user widgets and source demonstrations remain content, not chrome.

rules.name: The White Stage Rule
rules.body: Pure Canvas is the default field. Grey surfaces identify grouping or state and never become a competing page background.

rules.name: The Data Leads Rule
rules.body: Large type is reserved for a page-level idea or a value worth glancing at; interface explanation stays compact.

rules.name: The Scan Path Rule
rules.body: Layout should expose one clear reading or working path before adding secondary actions; responsive changes preserve that order rather than merely shrinking columns.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: Resting product surfaces stay flat; shadows identify a floating layer, a widget object, or a deliberate interactive lift.

rules.name: The Chrome Stays Compact Rule
rules.body: Do not import a widget's large corner radius into ordinary application controls or containers.

dos: Do use Pure Canvas, Interface Ink, and neutral borders as the default product frame.
Do reserve Widget Blue for active, focused, linked, selected, or singular high-intent actions.
Do keep controls compact and use spacing to separate groups rather than inflating every component.
Do let widget content carry theme-specific color inside a stable application frame.
Do stack responsive layouts in their original scan order and make the primary action easy to reach.
donts: Don't treat colors sampled from a source page or example widget as application brand colors.
Don't apply strong shadows to ordinary resting cards, fields, or rows.
Don't use large widget-style radii on standard application chrome.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent for routine interface state.
Don't make supporting explanation compete with values, previews, or the primary action.
